# v0.23.3-rc2 — maintenance point release candidate

**RELEASE CANDIDATE — not GA.** Second candidate. It differs from `v0.23.3-rc1` only by three amendments
to RELEASE-READINESS-V1 (#427), this notes file, and the release-candidate test pin — no product code. The
amendments: (1) the Phase C differential rule for pre-existing #247-class publication conflicts (zero NEW
conflicts; identity where the host exposes it, otherwise the position profile paired against the previous GA by a
mechanical rule within a same-host A/A′ jitter band; count alone never suffices) plus "this specification is never carry-safe"; (2) the receipt-publication
mechanism (tracker comments + sha256 of each body); (3) delta-scoped Phase B for a respin confined to bench/,
docs/, tests/ and release notes — the clause under which the rc1 Phase B receipt composes with a delta sweep
here. The rc1 Phase A and Phase C receipts carry under the carry-forward rule (Phase C re-evaluated under the
amended rule from a same-host differential); the diff-scope proof, the re-evaluation and the delta sweep are
recorded in the maintainers' release record and on the train tracker #419. GA follows with the GA tree = this
tree plus exactly one added file, `.github/release-notes/v0.23.3.md` (release.yml reads the notes for the tagged ref);
this rc2 notes file stays unchanged.

## Fixes: warmup, Teams backfill, a flaky test (#404, #408, #407)

- FastEmbed warmup now tries the locally cached model before enabling downloads; explicit warmup
  remains the only path allowed to download a missing model (#404, addresses #235 — a warmup that
  reached for the network although the model was already on disk; contributed by @Tosko4).
- Teams scope backfill is linear: each batch carries an ascending rowid cursor through session,
  derived and rollup backfills instead of rescanning already-stamped rows from rowid zero (#408,
  closes #386; contributed by @Tosko4). Teams remains dormant — this changes only the cost of the
  backfill when it runs.
- The atomic compaction-telemetry contention test no longer depends on runner scheduling: it keeps
  production's 100 ms best-effort telemetry policy unchanged and widens only the test's SQLite wait
  (#407, closes #328; contributed by @Tosko4). Test-only.

## Refactor: session-end prefix matching extracted (#155)

Session-end prefix matching moved from `engine.py` into `prefix_matching.py` as a mixin (recreated
from an upstream hermes-lcm continuation PR). Behaviour is unchanged: the extracted functions were
verified AST-identical to the originals at review time and the full suite passed. This is a seam
for later work, not a feature.

## Governance: exact-head receipt gate preserves valid peer receipts (#362)

The required "AI review exact-head" check's reconcile step no longer resets peer pull requests when
one pull request's own gate evaluation fails cleanly; valid exact-head receipts on peers are
preserved, and a transient API error during the final read now fails closed instead of leaving a
stale green peer check. Receipt dispatches must carry a `dispatch_id` (replay guard).
Maintainer-facing only; no product code.

## Records: benchmark registrations, ledger rows, documentation truth (#412, #413, #416)

- `bench/BASELINE-LEDGER.md` gained six boundary rows (#412): the v0.23.2 security/privacy train (#364,
  #366, #370, #374, #384+#391) and this release's #155 refactor, recorded as a ledger entry only on the
  strength of the 18/18 AST-identity check — no re-baseline required.
- The LongMemEval V1-M re-bank of FINDING-F53 under the shipped privacy posture was registered
  (#413, `bench/specs/RUN-SHEET-V1M-REBANK.md`) and then PARKED at its pre-spend gate: the cloud-copy
  transform changes 617 occurrences (93 units) across 258 of 500 questions and refuses 3 corpus
  texts (17 questions) — FINDING-F62 (#416). F53 stays the row of record at its original commit;
  nothing was banked and nothing moved. Instrument follow-ups: #415. Posture decision: #380.
- README, operator guide and project status now name v0.23.2 as the latest stable release and
  carry the forward identity `hermes-lcm v0.23.3 (15 tools)` for this candidate.

## Known follow-ups (tracked, non-blocking)

- #247 — summary publication can stall after a compaction rollover on long sessions (present since
  v0.22.0; disclosed in the v0.23.2 gauntlet; a fix is under review in #397).
- #394 — cloud-embedding redaction precision boundaries (best-effort by design; the durable store
  is lossless regardless).
- #369 — gate right-sizing: a push to main still resets every open pull request's required check
  until its receipts are re-issued.
- #415 — V1-M re-bank instrument items K1–K11, prerequisites for any re-execution.
- #380 — the privacy-posture decision for the re-bank. Owner ruling 2026-09-05: the cloud-copy
  transform becomes opt-in in the next feature train (v0.24.0). This point release does not change it.

## Benchmark boundary

No recall-path behaviour changed in this train: #155 is a verified no-behaviour-change refactor,
#404 touches embedding-model warmup only, #408 touches the dormant Teams backfill, #407 is
test-only. The banked rows (FINDING-F53 retrieval, F59 retention, F61 attribution) keep their
commits of record. The only ledger row this release adds is #155's (#412): "ledger entry only, no
re-baseline", so no scoreboard comparison is blocked by this train.
